errors.text: The predicted conductivity increase of 15–25% does not reproduce the target result of approximately 12%.
The mechanism incorrectly refers to reduced phonon scattering times tau as beneficial; reduced scattering requires a lower scattering rate and therefore a longer relaxation time.
The >10 THz high-frequency cutoff is unsupported and may lie above much of the phonon spectrum of this heavy refractory alloy.
